mapper.sql: member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, password AS password, name AS name, given_name AS givenName, family_name AS familyName, email AS email, nickname AS nickname, profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE login_id = #{loginId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (login_id, password, name, given_name, family_name, nickname, email) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{givenName}, #{familyName}, #{nickname}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET nickname = #{nickname} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE members SET password = #{password} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE members SET profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
